items.name: Mastercard Red
items.role: The left circle of the Mastercard mark — used only in the brand logo, never as a UI color.

items.name: Mastercard Yellow
items.role: The right circle of the Mastercard mark — used only in the brand logo, never as a UI color.

items.name: Ink Black
items.role: The warm near-black used for primary CTAs, headline text on cream, and the footer surface. Slightly warm (the 13 blue value pulls toward the cream) so it never…

items.name: Signal Orange
items.role: The burnt/rust CTA orange used on consent actions and eyebrow dots. Deeper than the brand yellow, brighter than ink — it's the page's single aggressive color a…

items.name: Light Signal Orange
items.role: A lighter carroty orange used for carousel active indicators and decorative orbital arcs. Always acts as an attention cue, never as body color.

items.name: Clay Brown
items.role: The deep rust used for secondary link-style buttons (e.g., cookie details). Sits between ink and signal orange.

items.name: Canvas Cream
items.role: The page canvas. Warm, putty-toned, the default body background. All editorial sections sit on this.

items.name: Lifted Cream
items.role: One step lighter than canvas — used for nested "raised" sections that want to feel like paper laid on paper.

items.name: White
items.role: Reserved for the floating navigation pill, modal cards, secondary button fills, and small satellite-CTA circles attached to image portraits.

items.name: Soft Bone
items.role: A cool-gray alternative surface used inside a handful of component subregions.

items.name: Ink Black
items.role: Primary headline and body text color.

items.name: Charcoal
items.role: A slightly softer black used for some text alternates.

items.name: Slate Gray
items.role: Muted secondary text — eyebrow label alternative, disabled states, "Privacy Choices" bottom-row text.

items.name: Granite
items.role: and Graphite (#565656): Deeper gray for inline body accents and link alternates.

items.name: Dust Taupe
items.role: Very muted cream-gray used for disabled or "whisper" text (e.g., placeholder-like empty state labels). Low contrast on cream; use only for subdued content.

items.name: Link Blue
items.role: A deep, slightly dusty blue used for inline links and informational callouts. Saturated enough to read as a link without being neon.

items.name: Deep card shadows
items.role: on elevated content (rgba(0,0,0,0.08) 0px 24px 48px) that create a soft halo beneath pill-shaped media
